name: Halloween Horror Massacre
author: Addicting Games
description: Halloween Horror Massacre is a scary-movie themed puzzle game that fans will enjoy. Your objective is to count down a creepy tree without bumping your head on a branch or before you run out of time. This is a casual puzzle game for fans of scary movies with creepy character skins and eerie music playing in the background. Your first free character is Freddy, the murderer that haunts nightmares. However, as you play along and earn points, you can unlock other monsters like Frankenstein, Jason, and Scream. Play until you unlock all of these killer characters. Then head over to the Leaderboards to see how you rank against other Halloween Horror Massacre players. Climb up the leaderboards or beat your own score in this spooky online game for scary-loving players.
